title: Reading-H physical-empty bounded test revalidation remains blocked
question: After later finite T-054/T-055 work, can TECT evaluate F_total[G_*]-F_total[E], full Reading-H stationarity and symmetry-projected transverse stability while preserving the exact R-420 common-owner contract and preregistering E without zero aliasing?
method: Hash-check R-169 v1.4, R-170, EXP-000790, R-418 and R-420 and freeze their authority roles before any numerical lane.
Revalidate the same fifteen common-owner fields and the exact G_* minus E orientation; treat absent values as missing rather than filling them from another owner.

finding: The six authorities retain the R-420 boundary: the Reading-H G_* covariance owner is not a hash-pinned common finite F_total, and no normalized physical-empty E branch or full Reading-H-to-P1 map is admitted. Primary and independent lanes therefore return BLOCKED with exact agreement on the fifteen-field identity lock, E admission status and all three requested verdicts; hostile mutations are rejected and Lean R427 compiles. No numerical energy, stationarity residual or Hessian is emitted.
decision_reason: The requested quantities remain undefined at the current owner boundary. The honest advance is an append-only revalidation card and executable blocker, not a zero-reference substitution, fabricated finite part or cross-owner comparison.

adversarial_review.check: Aliasing E to zero or the P1 zero/disordered reference is rejected without a registered full map.
Combining Reading-H G_* with a P1 or other finite parent is rejected as a cross-owner substitution.
Changing or omitting a frozen R-420 field rejects the revalidation identity.
An unspecified finite part or scalar shift cannot create the missing state-dependent comparison.
Covariance-owner stationarity is not promoted to full-field stationarity on an absent tangent.
No projected Hessian is formed without a common orbit tangent, projector and error budget.
A blocked input audit is not promoted to a physical vacuum, Yang-Mills result or mass gap.

boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing preregistration revalidation only. It proves no sign, stationarity, transverse stability, physical-empty identification, thermodynamic or continuum limit, Yang-Mills result, mass gap, C6, Sector-A or Pre-A closure.
decision_scope: Same-owner finite contract identity and E preregistration; no numerical evaluation and no tier change.
next_action: Require an owner-approved hash-pinned common finite-regulator parent, instantiate E with a normalized state or configuration, boundary preparation and local no-condensate criterion, map G_* and E into that parent, and freeze the full tangent, symmetry projector, finite parts and error budgets before rerunning the unchanged tests.
no_overclaim: This is a reproducible blocker at the current owner boundary, not a universal nonexistence theorem. It does not identify E with zero or a physical vacuum and does not provide a Yang-Mills or mass-gap conclusion.
